commit.message: test: define K3 evidence store conformance contract

green.expected_result: PASS with zero failures for the exact task verification command.

produces: `EvidenceStore` requires `accept`, `acceptBatch`, `getById`, `read`; every accept path returns `EvidenceStorageReceiptV1`, and every batch path returns `EvidenceBatchResultV1`.

phase: B — Fingerprint and durable reference stores
purpose: Execute approved K3 Task 7: EvidenceStore port/conformance harness

red.expected_failure_description: FAIL because the task's specified behavior is not yet implemented. Module/import/path/setup failure alone does not satisfy RED; repair the test harness until the intended behavioral assertion fails.

stop_conditions: On any spec/plan conflict, record `Ruling:` and follow the spec. On any unexpected failure, invoke `systematic-debugging` before editing implementation. A low-reasoning executor must not merge, integrate, or push directly to `main`; stop at the high-reasoning merge gate. - [ ] Write failing port/receipt-shape tests. - [ ] Execute the exact RED command from the Low-model execution contract above and confirm Expected RED. - [ ] Implement assertion + reusable conformance harness. - [ ] Execute the exact GREEN command from the Low-model execution contract above and confirm Expected GREEN. - [ ] Commit `test: define K3 evidence store conformance contract`.
